newsitem.title: USA: Kennametal says acquires M&A Supply Inc.
newsitem.headline: Kennametal says acquires M&A Supply Inc.

text.p: Kennametal Inc said Tuesday that it entered into an agreement to acquire, through its subsidiary, J&L America Inc, all the outstanding stock of Mill and Abrasive Supply Inc.
Mill and Abrasive, based in Roseville, Mich., had sales of $6 million in its latest fiscal year and employs approximately 34 people.

Michael Ruprich, director of global marketing and sales, said "This acquisition is another step in our growth strategy and will help us expand our leadership position as a preferred supplier to customers for metalworking consumables and related products."
Mill and Abrasive distributes metalcutting tools and industrial supplies.
Kennametal Inc manufactures cemented carbide, tools, accessories and other hard metal products.
